paths.description: Entry and mandatory 18+/Terms gate; tests first impression, legal interruption, preferences, semantics and security.
Accepted Posts listing; representative content index and primary browse task.
Tag-query and deliberately empty-query results; representative primary search flow and empty state.
Representative post-detail template, sampled with /posts/404 and current listing metadata.
Help/content template representing documentation and navigation depth.
Unknown route and zero-result search, covering HTTP and empty-state recovery.
Sign-in/account journey, selected because authentication security and input assistance are high-risk.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette is not connected to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The preference probe matched prefers-color-scheme: dark, but found color-scheme: normal and no prefers-color-scheme rules; the light and dark captures use the same palette.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark"> and :root { color-scheme: light dark }, then map surface tokens with light-dark() or a prefers-color-scheme fallback.

findings.summary: Route and major state changes do not use View Transitions.
findings.evidence: The rendered listing probe found no view-transition CSS, and the listing navigation video shows an abrupt full-document swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive cross-document View Transitions for MPA navigation and same-document transitions for large panel/state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not react to scroll position.
findings.evidence: The desktop and mobile listing captures show fixed-height navigation/news chrome, and CSS inspection found no scroll-driven timeline or scroll-state behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sticky header container and a scroll-state query or a lightweight progressive fallback to compact secondary chrome after scrolling.

findings.summary: The mandatory Terms gate is a form with role="dialog" rather than a native modal dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM evidence shows <form id="tos-form" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">; Lighthouse reports its ARIA role is inappropriate for the element.
findings.suggestedFix: Place the form inside a native <dialog>, open it with showModal(), preserve the explicit decline action, and let the top layer provide focus containment/inert behavior.

findings.summary: Several controls and links have undersized touch targets.
findings.evidence: The rendered listing probe measured toolbar buttons at 32×20px and multiple links at 15–20px high, below a comfortable 44×44 CSS pixel target, although keyboard focus remains visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase hit areas with padding/min-inline-size/min-block-size while retaining visible focus and compact visual glyphs.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 3.8s LCP on the entry surface; the accepted-listing trace measured 5.13s LCP. CLS was 0.004 and TBT was effectively zero.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce document latency and prioritize the actual LCP image/content; keep the strong main-thread and stability results.

findings.summary: Slow document response and render-blocking CSS delay first render.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.31s root response time and identified the 46.5KB stylesheet as render blocking with about 170ms potential savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Improve cached document generation/edge delivery, inline only critical gate styles, and defer or split non-critical CSS.

findings.summary: The entry surface ships mostly unused CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 43.4KB of 46.4KB CSS (93.5%) was unused on the entry surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Create a small gate/home critical stylesheet and load gallery/editor styles only on routes that need them.

findings.summary: Some tag and inline-link colors fail WCAG contrast requirements.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse/axe measured 3.55:1 for green tag text on #1f3c67 (4.5:1 required) and 1.73:1 differentiation between an inline link and surrounding text, with no underline.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise foreground contrast to at least 4.5:1 for normal text and add a non-color link cue such as underline.

findings.summary: The dialog role and several editor controls lack robust accessible semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags the form-as-dialog role; the listing DOM probe found visible post editor textareas/buttons with no label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native dialog semantics and provide explicit visible labels or accessible names for every editor control.

findings.summary: The listing lacks a main landmark and has a misleading heading outline.
findings.evidence: The rendered listing probe found NAV/NAV/FOOTER but no MAIN; its only H1 is “Edit”, while the visible primary section is “Posts”. Focus itself has a dotted outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary results in <main>, make “Posts” the H1, and place panel headings in a logical H2/H3 hierarchy.

findings.summary: Most listing images omit intrinsic width and height attributes.
findings.evidence: The rendered listing probe counted 76 images, 75 without width and height attributes. Current measured CLS was low, but intrinsic reservation is absent in authored markup.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width and height from each post’s known preview dimensions and preserve responsive sizing with height:auto.

findings.summary: Entry-page metadata is too generic to describe the site.
findings.evidence: The entry page title is only “e621”; listing meta description is only “e621”. The listing title is descriptive, but the description does not explain the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each public template a concise unique title and a human-readable description of its purpose.

findings.summary: At least one global navigation label is not descriptive.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse SEO flags the /static/site_map link text “More”; viewport metadata and real href links otherwise pass.
findings.suggestedFix: Rename “More” to “Site map” or provide an equally descriptive accessible name.

findings.summary: Listing share metadata is malformed or generic.
findings.evidence: The listing probe found og:title set to “ - e621” and og:description to “e621”, despite two JSON-LD blocks.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate accurate per-template Open Graph title/description and validate JSON-LD against visible content.

findings.summary: HSTS is effectively disabled and the header policy has avoidable gaps.
findings.evidence: Headers show Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=0, which disables HSTS; CSP allows unsafe-inline styles, Permissions-Policy is absent, and the nosniff header is malformed/duplicated in the capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS with a durable max-age after rollout validation, send one valid nosniff header, add a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, and remove unsafe-inline styles via nonces/hashes where feasible.

findings.summary: The app-like gallery advertises installability but has no offline worker.
findings.evidence: manifest.json provides name, icons, standalone display and start_url, but the service-worker probe found zero registrations and no controlling worker.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a bounded service worker with network-first HTML, cache-first versioned assets, and a useful offline fallback, or remove standalone install cues if offline resilience is not intended.

findings.summary: The stylesheet is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The listing correctly declares lang="en", but CSS inspection counted 499 physical-side declarations and no logical margin/padding/border declarations; dir is not explicitly declared.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate reusable layout rules to inline/block logical properties and verify a dir=rtl smoke test; keep language declarations accurate.

findings.summary: The homepage mascot image can be delivered more efficiently.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 18.9KB savings by serving the 64.5KB PNG mascot in a modern compressed format.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants for the mascot and use picture/source negotiation while keeping explicit dimensions.
